sequentialthinking.description: Use Sequential thinking when you need to think deeply about a subject, or to remember back simultaneously using tool calls to retrieve memories. This will help you provide better insight on a topic to the user. This is your primary reasoning capability.

fetch-urls.description: Use fetch when you need to retrieve a specific url for the user or for your own research purposes. This can be used post searxng-web-search to retrieve content. This is your primary method to surf the web.

searxng-web-search.description: Use SearXNG for web searches when the user asks questions about current events, needs up-to-date information, wants to look something up online, or when you need to verify facts. This is your primary web search capability.
